defect.seen: thin strands beside the parts at layer 21 (14:51), more by layer 30, a bird's nest beside one fixing shell and loose strands behind the other by layer 45-48 (15:24), the tangle behind both fixing shells by layer 60 (15:35), then a curtain of strings hanging from the main shells to the plate by layer ~190 (16:23). It never caught on the nozzle and no part moved
defect.likely_cause: unsupported overhangs. In this file the main shells print 'Floating vertical shell' (walls over nothing) on most layers from 18 to 68 and again on a few later ones (92-98, 147-148, 173-183), with no supports under them (supports were set only under the fixing shells); the fixing shells bridge at layers 29 and 41. The timing matches. Heavy PLA stringing can also mean damp filament; that wasn't checked
defect.decision: let it run: the parts' bodies looked sound in every close-up, nothing was caught on the nozzle, the fixing shells finished at layer 76, and stopping would have lost the main shells. Reported in the tracking comment at 15:26, 15:38, 15:54, 16:08 and 16:24; nobody asked to stop
